title: crypto2dev CI: Ubuntu 22.04 + 24.04 baseline run
description: Execute TEST_CRYPTO2DEV=1 TEST_LINUXKM=1 ./tests/ci/test-on-aws.sh on Ubuntu 22.04 (kernel 5.15) and Ubuntu 24.04 (kernel 6.8). Record: build success/failure for wolfcrypt.ko and crypto2dev.ko, module load/unload clean (no BUG/Oops), userspace wolfSSL tests passing, shim test results. Ubuntu is the primary target and should be the first distro validated.
notes: PASS: Ubuntu 22.04 (6.8 HWE, 16/0), Ubuntu 24.04 (6.17, 16/0). Both PASS with TEST_CRYPTO2DEV=1 TEST_LINUXKM=1. wolfcrypt.ko + crypto2dev.ko + crypto2dev_wolfssl.ko all load. /dev/crypto2dev present. wolfSSL rebuilt with --enable-crypto2dev. Shim test SKIP (standalone binary not built yet). Fixes: kcapi utsrelease.h include, LINUXKM_ASM_OPT.
